extracted.intended_audience: dataset creators, data engineers, ML practitioners, responsible-AI researchers, dataset publishers, and compliance officers who prepare or evaluate dataset documentation
extracted.subtask_description: Designing, authoring, or evaluating machine-readable dataset documentation (Croissant-RAI) that captures responsible-AI (RAI) attributes to improve discoverability, interoperability, maintainability, and regulatory compliance of ML datasets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use case: Data life cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: Document the dataset life cycle stages such as motivation, composition, collection, preprocessing, uses, distribution, and maintenance. Include creator, purpose, creation date, data sources, versioning, composition, processing, intended use, maintenance, provenance and lineage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompts creators to reflect on the process and aids user understanding. Document provenance and lineage for derived datasets. Examples: rai:dataCollection, rai:dataCollectionTimeframe, rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol. Use in discovery and to support reproducibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use case: Data labeling
rubrics_metrics.description: Document annotation/labeling processes and properties: how labels were created, platform used, number of human labels per record, rater demographics, annotation tool characteristics, and annotation instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essential to ensure label quality and to understand sample characteristics; facilitates sampling, assessing, replicating and reproducing labeling. Relevant properties include rai:dataAnnotationProtocol, rai:annotationsPerItem, rai:annotatorDemographics, rai:dataAnnotationPlatform, rai:machineAnnotationTools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use case: Participatory data
rubrics_metrics.description: Document participatory elements of dataset creation (community/collaborative work), including data collectors, their demographics, platforms used, and coordination/collection practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps surface biases and limitations from collaborative or citizen-science processes; supports monitoring, assessment, repeatability, and reproducing data collection (examples: Wikidata, crowdsourced datasets). Use annotator or collector demographics fields where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use case: AI safety and fairness evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Document safety and bias information, dataset limitations, sensitive/personal information, usage restrictions, and features used for safety/fairness assessments; often gathered at item level and aggregated to dataset-level (scorecards/nutrition labels).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include attributes that identify known biases, limitations and sensitive data to help prevent unintended harmful consequences; examples: rai:dataBiases, rai:dataLimitations, rai:personalSensitiveInformation, rai:dataSocialImpact. Can be presented as scorecards or nutrition labels for easy assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use case: Regulatory compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide structured documentation enabling legal/compliance assessment for privacy and AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act), including sensitive/personal identifiable information, data governance, security measures, sharing agreements, and handling protocols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports compliance officers and legal teams to evaluate dataset fit with regulations. Properties include rai:personalSensitiveInformation, rai:dataManipulationProtocol, rai:dataImputationProtocol, and rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Machine-readable & Schema.org / Croissant integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Dataset documentation should be machine-readable (JSON-LD) and integrated with Schema.org/Dataset and the Croissant metadata format to enable search engine discovery and standard structured representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Croissant-RAI is an extension of Croissant and Schema.org; use dct:conformsTo mlcommons.org/croissant/RAI/1.0 as shown in listings. Machine-readable structure enables automated discovery, indexing (Google Dataset Search), and tool integration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discoverability, portability, reproducibility, interoperability, ML-ready
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation should improve dataset discoverability (by search engines), portability across platforms, reproducibility of dataset creation, and interoperability with ML frameworks; prepare datasets to be directly loadable into frameworks like PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Croissant layers describe attributes, resources, structure and semantics; documenting preprocessing and manipulation protocols increases reproducibility. Use standardized properties so search engines and ML tools can consume metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocabulary engineering process / participatory co-design
rubrics_metrics.description: Design and curate the vocabulary through an iterative, stakeholder-led process including use-case definition, comparison with existing vocabularies, scope definition (competency questions), conceptualization/implementation, and evaluation via example annotations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure attributes align with stakeholder needs; run biweekly sprints, engage diverse experts, map Croissant-RAI properties to Croissant and Schema.org, and evaluate via example dataset annotations.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataCollection
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the data collection process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data life cycle. Cardinality: ONE. Example (HLS Burn Scar Scenes): include imagery sources, links, and high-level collection description. Also document raw sources (see rai:dataCollectionRawData) and timeframe (rai:dataCollectionTimeframe).

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataCollectionType
rubrics_metrics.description: Define the data collection type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data life cycle. Cardinality: MANY. Recommended values include Surveys, Secondary Data analysis, Physical data collection, Direct measurement, Document analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Experiments, Web Scraping, Web API, Focus groups, Self-reporting, Customer feedback data, User-generated content data, Passive Data Collection, Others.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataCollectionMissingData
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of missing data in structured/unstructured form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data life cycle. Cardinality: ONE. Document how missingness was observed, patterns, and handling implications for downstream use.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataCollectionRawData
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the raw data i.e. source of the data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data life cycle. Cardinality: ONE. Specify original sources (e.g., URLs, datasets, sensors), licensing and access constraints to aid provenance and reproducibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataCollectionTimeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: Timeframe in terms of start and end date of the collection process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:DateTime. Use Case: Data life cycle. Cardinality: MANY. Document dates or periods (seasonal/time-bound collection) relevant to validity and temporal generalization limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataImputationProtocol
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of data imputation process if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Compliance. Cardinality: ONE. Describe imputation methods, assumptions, parameters and potential pitfalls introduced by imputation.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataManipulationProtocol
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of data manipulation process if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Compliance. Cardinality: ONE. Include filtering, deduplication, HTML reconstruction, content filtering heuristics, and other manipulation steps (examples from BigScience Roots Corpus listing).

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the steps that were required to bring collected data to a state that can be processed by an ML model/algorithm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data life cycle. Cardinality: MANY. Document concrete preprocessing steps (filtering incomplete entries, normalization, tokenization, image centering, cloud filtering) to support reproducibility and enable users to understand dataset transformations.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataAnnotationProtocol
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of annotations (labels, ratings) produced, including how these were created or authored - Annotation Workforce Type, Annotation Characteristic(s), Annotation Description(s), Annotation Task(s), Annotation Distribution(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data labeling. Cardinality: ONE. Provide instructions given to annotators, question sets (DICES example), and how raw annotations map to final labels.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataAnnotationPlatform
rubrics_metrics.description: Platform, tool, or library used to collect annotations by human annotators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data labeling. Cardinality: MANY. Record platforms (crowdsourcing provider, in-house UI), UI specifics, and tool versions to facilitate replication.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Considerations related to the process of converting the “raw” annotations into the labels that are ultimately packaged in a dataset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data labeling. Cardinality: MANY. Describe uncertainty/disagreement handling, systematic annotator disagreements across demographics, quality filtering (DICES filtered 19 of 123 raters), and consolidation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan
rubrics_metrics.description: Versioning information in terms of the updating timeframe, the maintainers, and the deprecation policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Compliance. Cardinality: MANY. Provide maintainers, update schedules, deprecation policies, and how users are notified of changes to support dataset lifecycle management.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:personalSensitiveInformation
rubrics_metrics.description: Sensitive Human Attribute(s) - Gender, Socio-economic status, Geography, Language, Age, Culture, Experience or Seniority, Others (please specify).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Compliance. Cardinality: MANY. Explicitly note presence of PII or sensitive attributes and how they are handled, redacted, or flagged for downstream users and compliance assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataSocialImpact
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion of social impact, if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: AI safety and fairness evaluation. Cardinality: ONE. Provide reflections on potential societal harms, intended/undesired uses, mitigation strategies, and risk assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataBiases
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of biases in dataset, if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: AI safety and fairness evaluation. Cardinality: MANY. Describe identified biases, sub-ratings specifying types of safety concern, hate speech types, bias categories, and any quantification or evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataLimitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Known limitations - Data generalization limits (e.g. related to data distribution, data quality issues, or data sources) and non-recommended uses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: AI safety and fairness evaluation. Cardinality: MANY. List limitations such as over-represented content types, incomplete PII removal, language variety imbalance (BigScience example) and recommend non-recommended uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:dataUseCases
rubrics_metrics.description: Dataset Use(s) - Training, Testing, Validation, Development or Production Use, Fine Tuning, Others (please specify), Usage Guidelines. Recommended uses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: AI safety and fairness evaluation. Cardinality: MANY. State recommended and discouraged usages aligned with intended scope and regulatory constraints (align with AI Act classification where relevant).

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:annotationsPerItem
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of human labels per dataset item.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data labeling. Cardinality: ONE. Provide counts to inform label reliability and sampling strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:annotatorDemographics
rubrics_metrics.description: List of demographics specifications about the annotators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data labeling. Cardinality: MANY. Report gender, age cohorts, race/ethnicity, and consent information (DICES example provided full demographic breakdown and consent for collecting detailed demographics). Use this to assess representation and potential annotation biases.

rubrics_metrics.name: rai:machineAnnotationTools
rubrics_metrics.description: List of software used for data annotation (e.g. concept extraction, NER, and additional characteristics of the tools used for annotation to allow for replication or extension).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExpectedType: sc:Text. Use Case: Data labeling. Cardinality: MANY. Document versioned toolchains and algorithms used for automatic annotations and relevant settings to support replication and interpretation of machine-derived labels.
